title: 2022年度 第2回検定一次試験 英検4級 リスニング

parts.name: 第1部
parts.description: イラストを参考にしながら対話を聞き、その最後の文に対する応答として最も適切なものを選ぶ形式です。選択肢は音声で放送されます。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: These newspapers are heavy!

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Are you recycling them?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Yes.  Could you help me?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「新聞をリサイクルするの、手伝ってくれる？」への返答。
highlights: Could you help me?
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「いいよ、お母さん」→正解。2「読書が好き」→新聞。3「理解できない」→無関係。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Is your sister in a band, too?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: What does she play?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: バンドにいる姉妹について「彼女は何の楽器を演奏するの？」への返答。
highlights: What does she play?
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「トランペットだよ」→正解。2「高校で」→場所。3「音楽の先生」→無関係。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: What are you going to get for Dad’s birthday?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Some socks.  How about you?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I’ll make him a photo frame.

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「お父さんの誕生日に写真立てを作ろうと思うの」への返答。
highlights: I’ll make him a photo frame.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「お父さんは喜ぶよ」→正解。2「あとで電話するよ」→無関係。3「ケーキをもらうよ」→無関係。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Mr. Warner, you have a visitor.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Who is it?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Mr. Smith.

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「お客様のスミスさんがいらっしゃってます」への返答。
highlights: Mr. Smith.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「2時で大丈夫」→時間。2「これが私のレポートです」→無関係。3「すぐに行くよ」→正解。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Happy birthday, James.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Thanks, Grandma.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Are you going to have a party tonight?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「今夜パーティーをするの？」への返答。
highlights: Are you going to have a party tonight?
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「美味しかった」→過去形。2「うん、レストランでね」→正解。3「新しいジャケットだよ」→無関係。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: What did you do yesterday?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I watched a movie about birds.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: How was it?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「映画（鳥について）はどうだった？」への返答。
highlights: How was it?
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「魚を2匹飼っている」→無関係。2「面白かったよ」→正解。3「それだけだよ」→不適切。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I went to the shopping mall today.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Did you buy anything?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Yes.  These gloves.

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「（ショッピングモールで）この手袋を買ったんだ」への返答。
highlights: Did you buy anything?
Yes.  These gloves.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「いいね」→正解。2「私が見つけるよ」→無関係。3「今日は閉まっているよ」→無関係。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Are you looking for a cap?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Yes.  I want a white one.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: This one is only $10.

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「この（白い帽子）はたったの10ドルだよ」への返答。
highlights: This one is only .
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「これにします」→正解。2「そう思うよ」→無関係。3「案内できるよ」→無関係。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Let’s buy some flowers for your mother.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Good idea.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Is there a flower shop near here?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「この近くに花屋さんはある？」への返答。
highlights: Is there a flower shop near here?
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「バラを12本買ったよ」→買った後。2「とても綺麗だね」→無関係。3「スーパーのそばにあるよ」→正解。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Do you have any pets?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Yes, I have two hamsters.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Where are they?

questions.question: What is the best response?
questions.explanation: 「ハムスターは（今）どこにいるの？」への返答。
highlights: Where are they?
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「生後10ヶ月だよ」→年齢ではない。2「ニンジンが好きだよ」→好物ではない。3「私の寝室にいるよ」→正解。

parts.name: 第2部
parts.description: 対話を聞き、その質問に対して最も適切な答えを1, 2, 3, 4の中から一つ選ぶ形式です。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Mom, I need to go to school early tomorrow.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I have band practice for the concert.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: OK.

questions.question: Why does the boy have to go to school early tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 「男の子が明日早く学校に行く理由は？」「バンドの練習があるから」。
highlights: I have band practice for the concert.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「コンサートを見るため」→練習。2「バンドの練習」→正解。3「宿題をするため」→無関係。4「教室を掃除するため」→無関係。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I’m sorry I’m late, Dad.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Did you take the bus?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: No.  It didn’t come, so I walked home.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Next time, call me.  I’ll pick you up.

questions.question: Why was the girl late?
questions.explanation: 「女の子が遅刻した理由は？」「バスが来なかったから歩いた」。
highlights: It didn’t come, so I walked home.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「バスが来なかった」→正解。2「電車が止まった」→バス。3「電話が見つからなかった」→無関係。4「間違ったバスに乗った」→乗れなかった。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Marcy, walk the dog.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Can I do it after lunch?  I’m watching TV now.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: No, we’re going to visit Grandpa then.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: OK, I’ll do it.

questions.question: What is Marcy doing now?
questions.explanation: 「マーシーは今何をしている？」「テレビを見ている」。
highlights: I’m watching TV now.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「祖父を訪問している」→後で。2「犬の散歩」→後で。3「昼食を作っている」→無関係。4「テレビを見ている」→正解。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Do you want to play tennis?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I left my racket at school.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: That’s OK.  You can use my mom’s.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Great, thanks.

questions.question: Whose tennis racket will the girl use?
questions.explanation: 「女の子は誰のラケットを使う？」「男の子の母親のもの」。
highlights: You can use my mom’s.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「男の子のもの」→母親の。2「男の子の母親のもの」→正解。3「自分自身の」→忘れた。4「彼女の母親のもの」→男の子の母親のもの。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Mom, do you know Uncle Bill’s address?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Yes.  Why?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I want to send him a birthday card.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: That’s nice of you.

questions.question: What does the boy want to do?
questions.explanation: 「男の子は何をしたい？」「（ビルおじさんの）誕生日カードを送りたい」。
highlights: I want to send him a birthday card.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「地図を買う」→無関係。2「カードを送る」→正解。3「おじに電話する」→無関係。4「コンピュータを使う」→無関係。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Hi, Mike.  Are you watching the basketball game on TV?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Jaylen Porter is playing very well.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Yes, he is.

questions.question: What are they talking about?
questions.explanation: 「ふたりは何について話している？」「テレビでやっているバスケの試合」。
highlights: Are you watching the basketball game
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「バスケのコーチ」→プロ選手の話。2「新しいテレビ」→試合。3「バスケの試合」→正解。4「新しい先生」→無関係。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: What did you do today, Tim?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I went to the shopping center to buy a notebook.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Is it for school?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Yes, for Spanish class.

questions.question: Why did Tim go to the shopping center?
questions.explanation: 「ティムがショッピングセンターに行った理由は？」「（スペイン語の授業の）ノートを買うため」。
highlights: to buy a notebook.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「同級生に会う」→無関係。2「母親に会う」→無関係。3「ノートを買う」→正解。4「スペインの食べ物を買う」→ノート。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Happy birthday, Jim.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Thanks, Ms. Clark.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Did you get any cards from your classmates?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: I got one from Maria and one from Sam.

questions.question: Whose birthday is it today?
questions.explanation: 「今日は誰の誕生日？」「『誕生日おめでとう、ジム』と言っている」。
highlights: Happy birthday, Jim.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「ジムの」→正解。2「マリアの」→無関係。3「サムの」→無関係。4「クラーク先生の」→無関係。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Dad, do you have to work this weekend?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Only on Saturday morning.

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Can we go to the park on Sunday afternoon?

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Sure.

questions.question: When will they go to the park?
questions.explanation: 「彼らはいつ公園に行く？」「（男の子）日曜日の午後行ける？」「（父）もちろん」。
highlights: Can we go to the park on Sunday afternoon?
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「土曜日の朝」→仕事。2「土曜日の午後」→日曜。3「日曜日の朝」→午後。4「日曜日の午後」→正解。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Hello.  What would you like?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Two sandwiches and one rice ball, please.

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Would you like some drinks, too?

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Yes.  Three bottles of cola.

questions.question: How many sandwiches does the woman want?
questions.explanation: 「女性はサンドイッチをいくつ欲しい？」「サンドイッチを2つ、おにぎりを1つ」。
highlights: Two sandwiches
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「1つ」→おにぎり。2「2つ」→正解。3「3つ」→コーラの本数。4「4つ」→無関係。

parts.name: 第3部
parts.description: 英文を聞き、その質問に対して最も適切な答えを1, 2, 3, 4の中から一つ選ぶ形式です。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Here is your key.  Your room number is 205.  The restaurant on the second floor is open until ten o’clock.  Enjoy your stay.

questions.question: Where is the man talking?
questions.explanation: 「男性はどこで話している？」「鍵です。部屋は205号室です。2階のレストランは10時まで…」。
highlights: Your room number is 205.  The restaurant on the second floor
Enjoy your stay.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「学校」→無関係。2「ホテル」→正解。3「カフェ」→無関係。4「駅」→無関係。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: My American friends came to Japan last week.  I took them to a sumo tournament.  We also went sightseeing, but they enjoyed eating sushi the most.

questions.question: What did the man’s friends enjoy the most?
questions.explanation: 「男性の友人が一番楽しんだことは何？」「（相撲や観光もしたが）寿司を食べるのを一番楽しんだ」。
highlights: they enjoyed eating sushi the most.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「相撲を見ること」→一番ではない。2「観光」→一番ではない。3「風呂」→無関係。4「寿司を食べること」→正解。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: My friend Sarah had a party tonight.  But I was sick and couldn’t go.  I stayed at home.

questions.question: What did the boy do tonight?
questions.explanation: 「男の子は今夜何をした？」「サラのパーティーに行けず、家にいた」。
highlights: I was sick and couldn’t go.  I stayed at home.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「パーティーに行った」→行けなかった。2「友人を訪問した」→行けなかった。3「家にいた」→正解。4「病院に行った」→言及なし。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: This morning, Sally made a doll.  Tomorrow, she’s going to visit her grandfather.  She wants to show him the doll.

questions.question: What is Sally going to do tomorrow?
questions.explanation: 「サリーは明日何をする？」「（今日作った人形を）おじいちゃんに見せるために会いに行く」。
highlights: Tomorrow, she’s going to visit her grandfather.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「祖父を訪問する」→正解。2「人形を作る」→今日作った。3「おもちゃ屋に行く」→無関係。4「人形を買う」→作った。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: It’s my father’s birthday today, so I’m making a cake.  It’s in the oven now, but I just remembered something important.  I forgot to use sugar!

questions.question: What is the girl’s problem?
choices: She forgot to buy a cake.
questions.explanation: 「女の子の問題は何？」「ケーキを焼いているが、砂糖を使い忘れた」。
highlights: I forgot to use sugar!
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「掃除しなかった」→無関係。2「プレゼントを買わなかった」→作っている。3「砂糖を使い忘れた」→正解。4「ケーキを買い忘れた」→作っている。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Good morning, class.  This week, we have some exciting events at school.  The speech contest is on Wednesday.  And on Friday, a jazz band will perform in the gym.

questions.question: When is the speech contest?
questions.explanation: 「スピーチコンテストはいつ？」「スピーチコンテストは水曜日です」。
highlights: The speech contest is on Wednesday.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「水曜日」→正解。2「木曜日」→無関係。3「金曜日」→バンド演奏。4「週末」→無関係。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Debra wanted to take her umbrella to school today because it was raining.  It wasn’t by the front door, so she looked in her father’s car.  She found it there.

questions.question: Where was Debra’s umbrella?
questions.explanation: 「デブラの傘はどこにあった？」「玄関にはなく、父親の車の中で見つけた」。
highlights: she looked in her father’s car.  She found it there.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「学校」→無関係。2「玄関のドアのそば」→なかった。3「父親の車の中」→正解。4「彼女の部屋」→無関係。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: Yuka loves cooking.  She cooks dinner for her family twice a week.  She also makes pancakes for breakfast once a month.

questions.question: How often does Yuka make pancakes for breakfast?
questions.explanation: 「ユカはどのくらいの頻度で朝食にパンケーキを作る？」「月に一回」。
highlights: makes pancakes for breakfast once a month.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「月に1回」→正解。2「月に2回」→夕食。3「週に1回」→無関係。4「週に2回」→夕食。

lines.speaker: female
lines.text: I like making clothes.  Last month, I made a sweater and a dress.  Next, I’m going to make a scarf for my husband.

questions.question: What will the woman make next?
questions.explanation: 「女性は次に何を作る？」「夫のためにスカーフ（マフラー）を作る」。
highlights: Next, I’m going to make a scarf for my husband.
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「セーター」→先月。2「スカーフ（マフラー）」→正解。3「ドレス」→先月。4「シャツ」→無関係。

lines.speaker: male
lines.text: Yesterday, Matt’s basketball team had a picnic.  He took some potato chips, and his friend took some cookies.  His coach took many drinks.

questions.question: What did Matt take to the picnic?
questions.explanation: 「マットは何を持っていった？」「彼（マット）はポテトチップスを持って行った」。
highlights: He took some potato chips
questions.choiceAnalysis: 1「サラダ」→無関係。2「クッキー」→友人が。3「飲み物」→コーチが。4「ポテトチップス」→正解。
